header: What changes for crews in the first quarter
subheadline: Here is what the first 90 days usually look like for a team of 20 to 140 technicians.

items.title: Fewer hours lost to travel
items.description: Route-aware scheduling cut travel time by 22 minutes per job at Halden Facilities. That is about one extra call per technician per day.

items.title: Higher first-time fix rate
items.description: Asset history, warranty status and the last three reports open with the job. At Halden Facilities, first-time fixes have risen from 68% to 81% since March 2024.

items.title: Invoices out the same evening
items.description: Signed job sheets, parts and travel time reach your accounting export when the technician closes the call, not on Friday afternoon.
